testprocedures.name: RSV
testprocedures.protocol:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
    <Experiment Type="Absolute" Name="%%testname%%">
        <Protocol>
            <Hotlid>105</Hotlid>
            <LiqQuant>40</LiqQuant>
            <Stages>
                <Stage Type="Holding">
                    <Steps>
                    <Step Temp="50" Time="00:05:00" Rate="4" Sampling="False"/>
                    <Step Temp="95" Time="00:05:00" Rate="4" Sampling="False"/>
                    </Steps>
                </Stage>
                <Stage Type="Cycle">
                    <CycleCount>40</CycleCount>
                    <Steps>
                    <Step Temp="95" Time="00:00:05" Rate="4" Sampling="False"/>
                    <Step Temp="60" Time="00:00:30" Rate="4" Sampling="True"/>
                    </Steps>
                </Stage>
            </Stages>
        </Protocol>
        <Detectors>
            <Detector Id="1" Name="ROX" Dye="ROX"/>
            <Detector Id="2" Name="CY5" Dye="cy5"/>
        </Detectors>
        <Wells>
            %%wells%%
        </Wells>
        <Gain Type="Reference"/>
        <ConcentrationUnit></ConcentrationUnit>
    </Experiment>

results.name: positiv
results.conditions:
CT(CY5) > 5,
CT(CY5) < 40,
FL(CY5) > Thresh(CY5),
CT(ROX) > 5,
FL(ROX) > Thresh(ROX)

testprocedures.protocol:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
    <Experiment Type="Absolute" Name="%%testname%%">
        <Protocol>
            <Hotlid>105</Hotlid>
            <LiqQuant>40</LiqQuant>

                    <Steps>
                    <Step Temp="95" Time="00:05:00" Rate="4" Sampling="False"/>
                    </Steps>

                    <CycleCount>45</CycleCount>
                    <Steps>
                    <Step Temp="95" Time="00:00:05" Rate="4" Sampling="False"/>
                    <Step Temp="57" Time="00:00:30" Rate="4" Sampling="True"/>
                    <Step Temp="72" Time="00:00:05" Rate="4" Sampling="False"/>
                    </Steps>
                </Stage>
            </Stages>
        </Protocol>
        <Detectors>
            <Detector Id="1" Name="FAM" Dye="FAM"/>
            <Detector Id="2" Name="HEX" Dye="HEX"/>
            <Detector Id="3" Name="CY5" Dye="cy5"/>
            <Detector Id="4" Name="ROX" Dye="ROX"/>
        </Detectors>
        <Wells>
            %%wells%%
        </Wells>
        <Gain Type="Reference"/>
        <ConcentrationUnit></ConcentrationUnit>
    </Experiment>

results.name: MRSA
results.conditions:
CT(FAM) > 5,
CT(FAM) < 40,
FL(FAM) > Thresh(FAM),
CT(HEX) > 5,
CT(HEX) < 40,
FL(HEX) > Thresh(HEX),
CT(ROX) > 5,
CT(ROX) < 40,
FL(ROX) > Thresh(ROX)

results.name: MSSA

results.name: Staphylococcus spp.

CT(ROX) < 40,
FL(ROX) > Thresh(ROX),

results.name: Ungültig

CT(FAM) < 5 || FL(FAM) < Thresh(FAM),
